Are there any public repos that you're seeing this on? Might help repro the issue. Also I wonder if this might be a `libgit2` issue? https://github.com/starship/starship/issues/1628
Sadly, i can't give access, but i can do some of your shell execution to help resolve issue faster

I'm seeing the same issue on linux+bash across several repos. A couple of repos don't show the problem. I can't identify any common factors.

Is there any way to output what starship is doing?

@Deracination You can try running with `STARSHIP_LOG=trace`, e.g. `STARSHIP_LOG=trace starship prompt`, but that is dependent on how much logging is present in the module, and I don't think there's very much in the status module, unfortunately.

Interesting, so that is sort of expected since we have the default command_timeout set to 500ms so if running `git status`takes longer than that it will timeout and we get the warnings. As the warning mentions if you increase the `command_timeout` e.g ```toml command_timeout = 1000 ``` it should (hopefully) start working.
We have just released v0.52.1 which should fix this so going to close this. Please feel free to reopen it if this is not the case.
Yes, issue was fixed, thank you
